issues.title: Broken text spacing in menu items
issues.description: Several menu item labels contain irregular spacing within words, breaking legibility.
issues.evidence: Labels render as 'N ew sec ure note', 'N ew f older', 'Lock wh en id le', and 'De le te this vault...'.
issues.suggestion: Remove extraneous spaces or reset tracking and letter-spacing styles on MenubarItem text.
issues.triageNote: Source strings are clean ('New secure note', 'New folder', 'Lock when idle', 'Delete this vault…') and no tracking/letter-spacing is applied to MenubarItem labels (only MenubarShortcut has intentional tracking-widest on ⌘-chips); the only letter-spacing rules on pair-047 are InputOTP's noscript fallback and hidden autofill input; eval-agent DOM inspection found letter/word-spacing normal — classic JPEG misread of small antialiased text.

issues.title: Icon and label collision
issues.description: The filter icon overlaps directly with the label text.
issues.evidence: The sliders icon touches the letter 'F' in 'Filters' inside the menubar.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal spacing between the icon and the text label.
issues.triageNote: MenubarTrigger had 'flex items-center' but no gap, so icon children (SlidersHorizontalIcon) rendered flush against trigger text; added gap-2, matching DropdownMenuItem/SubTrigger treatment. Also converted physical utilities (pl-8/pr-2/left-2/ml-auto) to logical RTL-safe ones (ps-8/pe-2/start-2/ms-auto) to mirror the dropdown-menu fixes.
